reviewer: Independent batch_review; actual five baseline PNGs and full request anchors

design-intent.reason: Core swordsman colors/equipment present; face blurred and chest/back armor obscured by clothing.

silhouette.reason: Front readable; side/back equipment relations unstable, pants protrude through rear garment.

form-proportion.reason: Torso armor does not contain the torso; bracers not fitted to forearm axes; hip garment volume insufficient; sword grip unformed.

materials.reason: Metal/leather/cloth types recognizable; face/eyes/hairline smeared and hair highlights inconsistent.

craft.reason: Large chest/collar/back, bracer/glove and hip/garment intersections; open hand does not grip sword.

use-readability.reason: Observed zero rig/animation; requested continuous skills and effects absent.

acceptance: NO_SHIP baseline. Source geometry completeness does not establish fit, anatomy, rig or animation.
